english.title: Disclose confidential or sensitive information obtained under regulation 82(1)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) which had been disclosed to you under or by virtue of regulation 82(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 otherwise than in accordance with legislation authorising or requiring such disclosure, the information being information

(A)_[which related to a person's trade secret or which otherwise was or might have been commercially confidential in relation to someone]_
(B)_[whose disclosure otherwise than under or by virtue of that regulation would, in the opinion of the Secretary of State, be contrary to the interests of national security]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 82(6) and 91(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
